(3) PALMISTRY - the EXTERNAL out-of-process watcher that survives Handshake freezes/crashes/heavy-CPU; register a tracker where a behavior's liveness/freeze/crash is worth surviving-capture. internal_diagnostics (internal self-sense) + Palmistry (external observation) record NO project/sensitive data (typed allowlist; standard mechanism names kept - heartbeat/minidump/watchdog/ring-buffer). They SUPPLEMENT, never replace, the Flight Recorder.
